title: 1701 Prairie's front steps and basement windows
items: The Hibbard house's front steps are now low, open steps tucked under the entrance arch, as the old photograph shows them, so the stone porch's base and all four of its round medallions stand clear above the fence.

Small round-headed basement windows now show above the fence: a pair under the stone bay's windows and one under the narrow window of the low south wing. The house now matches both of its old photographs.
